title: Platform references
description: Shared platform resources referenced by every project (projects/_platform/platform.yaml). Owned by the platform team; the engine only reads it.

log_analytics_workspace_id.title: Central Log Analytics workspace
log_analytics_workspace_id.description: Resource ID of the workspace that receives Activity Logs and diagnostics.

hubs.title: Hub networks
hubs.description: One entry per environment and region. A project peers to the hub with its own environment and location.

virtual_network_id.description: Resource ID of the hub VNet.

address_space.description: Hub address space. Used by the 'hub' alias in NSG rules and by the overlap checks.

dns_servers.description: DNS servers offered to peered projects (e.g. DNS Private Resolver inbound endpoint).

firewall_private_ip.description: When set, project subnets get a default route (0.0.0.0/0) to this firewall.

use_remote_gateways.description: Project peerings use the hub VPN/ExpressRoute gateway. Requires a gateway in the hub.
